name: laravel-fsm_uuid_documentation
observations: Fixed FsmLog UUID/ULID documentation in README.md
Original documentation incorrectly suggested extending and adding/removing traits
PHP doesn't allow removing parent traits in child classes
Adding HasUlids to a class that extends one with HasUuids causes method conflicts
Provided two working approaches: (1) Copy entire model and modify traits, (2) Extend and override key methods
Used GitHub URL reference instead of vendor path for better maintainability
Committed changes in commits 69192ce through e798171
